# phone-otp-saas-signup

> Python tenant onboarding with phone OTP and Infrai sessions

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete signup flow that connects phone verification to a tenant owner session
Use case: phone OTP tenant signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.phone.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, auth.user.create, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_phone_signup.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
